message.content: On February 24, 1815, the ship Pharaon arrives in Marseilles after the death of Captain Leclere, and young sailor Edmond Dantès, praised for his seamanship and loyalty, is promised the captaincy by shipowner Monsieur Morrel, despite growing jealousy from the supercargo Danglars, before Edmond departs to visit his father and his betrothed Mercédès.
